title: Aşkın de Hali
author: Büşra Yılmaz
description: It begins like an ordinary love story, but with every page, hearts are broken. Defne and Mert’s relationship is tested by a series of misfortunes that tie their lives to four others, each haunted by a love from the past. As their paths cross, the six stories intertwine, revealing long-buried secrets and unexpected connections. In the end, they all discover that love, in its many forms—lost, unspoken, rekindled, and new— has been right in front of them all along.
